title: Madodari laments on Ravana's death
introduction: Mandodari stares at the dead body of Ravana and laments, recollecting the strength and power of Ravana. But, she realizes that Rama, who killed Ravana, is none other than Vishnu the lord of maintenance of the world. She further laments that Ravana has done a sinful deed in abducting Seetha and that he has faced the consequence in the form of his death; in the hands of Rama. She describes the charming personality and the unconquerable prowess of Ravana, but expresses her surprise how he has been killed by a mortal like Rama. Mandodari's co-wives console her. Meanwhile, Rama asks Vibhishana to perform obsequies to Ravana. Initially, Vibhishana refuses to perform the last rites, but when Rama convinces him, he begins to perform the funeral of Ravana. After the funeral is over, Vibhishana comes and joins Rama, who along with Lakshmana, Sugreeva and others experience happiness for having destroyed their enemy.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकादशाधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 111th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तासां विलपमानानां तथा राक्षसयोषिताम् |
ज्येष्ठा पत्नी प्रिया दीना भर्तारं समुदैक्षत
verses.iast:
tāsāṃ vilapamānānāṃ tathā rākṣasayoṣitām |
jyeṣṭhā patnī priyā dīnā bhartāraṃ samudaikṣata
verses.translation: While those consorts were weeping on that occasion, Mandodari, the senior most and beloved wife of Ravana, who was feeling miserable, stared at her husband.

glosses.meaning: very miserable as she was feeling.

verses.devanagari:
दशग्रीवन् हतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा |
पतिं मन्दोदरी तत्र कृपणा पर्यदेवयत्
verses.iast:
daśagrīvan hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇācintyakarmaṇā |
patiṃ mandodarī tatra kṛpaṇā paryadevayat
verses.translation: Gazing at Ravana, her husband who was killed by Rama of unimaginable exploits, Mandodari there, miserably lamented (as follows):

glosses.meaning: who was capable of doing unimaginable tasks

verses.devanagari:
ननु नाम महाबाहो तव वैश्रवणानुज |
क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुन् त्रस्यत्यपि पुरन्दरः
verses.iast:
nanu nāma mahābāho tava vaiśravaṇānuja |
kruddhasya pramukhe sthātun trasyatyapi purandaraḥ
verses.translation: "O the great armed, the brother of Kubera! Even Indra the destroyer of strongholds, indeed dares not to stand before you, when you were enraged."

glosses.meaning: even Indra the destroyer of strong holds

verses.devanagari:
ऋषयश्च महीदेवा गन्धर्वाश्च यशस्विनः |
ननु नाम तवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्च दिशो गताः
verses.iast:
ṛṣayaśca mahīdevā gandharvāśca yaśasvinaḥ |
nanu nāma tavodvegāccāraṇāśca diśo gatāḥ
verses.translation: "Because of fear from you, eminent sages, illustrious Gandharvas the celestial musicians and the wandering bards indeed fled in all directions."

verses.devanagari:
स त्वं मानुषमात्रेण रामेण युधि निर्जितः |
न व्यपत्रपसे राजन् किमिदं राक्षसर्षभ
verses.iast:
sa tvaṃ mānuṣamātreṇa rāmeṇa yudhi nirjitaḥ |
na vyapatrapase rājan kimidaṃ rākṣasarṣabha
verses.translation: "O the lord of demons! O king! How is it that you are not ashamed, though you were conquered in battle, by Rama, a mere mortal?"

verses.devanagari:
कथन् त्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्य श्रिया वीर्येण चान्वितम् |
अविषह्यन् जघान त्वं मानुषो वनगोचरः
verses.iast:
kathan trailokyamākramya śriyā vīryeṇa cānvitam |
aviṣahyan jaghāna tvaṃ mānuṣo vanagocaraḥ
verses.translation: "How did a mortal, wandering in a forest, killed you, who having overcome the three worlds by dint of your prowess, had grown irresistible and were endowed with glory?"

verses.devanagari:
मानुषाणामविषये चरतः कामरूपिणः |
विनाशस्तव रामेण सन्युगे नोपपद्यते
verses.iast:
mānuṣāṇāmaviṣaye carataḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
vināśastava rāmeṇa sanyuge nopapadyate
verses.translation: "It is not possible of annihilation of yourself, who lived in a place not accessible to men and was able to assume any form at your will, by Rama in battle."

glosses.meaning: in a place not accessible to men
and were able to assume any form at your will

verses.devanagari:
न चैतत्कर्म रामस्य श्रद्दधामि चमूमुखे |
सर्वतः समुपेतस्य तव तेनाभिमर्शनम्
verses.iast:
na caitatkarma rāmasya śraddadhāmi camūmukhe |
sarvataḥ samupetasya tava tenābhimarśanam
verses.translation: "I do not believe this act of Rama in the battle-front, nor do I believe of the attack by him, on your army, fully equipped with all the implements of war."

glosses.meaning: fully equipped with all implements of war.

verses.devanagari:
यदैव च जनस्थाने राक्षनैर्बहुभिर्वृतः |
खरस्तव हतो भ्राता तदैवानौ न मानुषः
verses.iast:
yadaiva ca janasthāne rākṣanairbahubhirvṛtaḥ |
kharastava hato bhrātā tadaivānau na mānuṣaḥ
verses.translation: "The moment your brother Khara was killed by Rama in Janasthana, though surrounded by a multitude of demons, it became evident that Rama was really no mortal."

verses.devanagari:
यदिअव नगरीं लङ्कां दुष्प्रवेशां सुरैरपि |
प्रविष्टो हनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम्
verses.iast:
yadiava nagarīṃ laṇ^kāṃ duṣpraveśāṃ surairapi |
praviṣṭo hanumānvīryāttadaiva vyathitā vayam
verses.translation: "We felt painful, the moment Hanuma penetrated, by dint of his prowess, deep into the City of Lanka, which was difficult to be entered even for gods."

glosses.meaning: which was difficult to be entered

verses.devanagari:
यदिअव वानरैर्घोरैर्बद्दः सेतुर्महार्णवे |
तदैव हृदयेनाहं शङ्के रामममानुषम्
verses.iast:
yadiava vānarairghorairbaddaḥ seturmahārṇave |
tadaiva hṛdayenāhaṃ śaṇ^ke rāmamamānuṣam
verses.translation: "The day when the terrific monkeys built a bridge on the great ocean, that day itself I believed that Rama was not an ordinary mortal."

verses.devanagari:
अथवा रामरूपेण कृतान्तः स्वयमागतः |
मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम्
verses.iast:
athavā rāmarūpeṇa kṛtāntaḥ svayamāgataḥ |
māyāṃ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām
verses.translation: "Otherwise, for your destruction, Yama, the lord of Death came himself assuming the form of Rama having arranged an unimaginable form of illusion."

verses.devanagari:
अथवा वासवेन त्वं धर्षितोऽसि महाबल |
वासवस्य तु का शक्तिस्त्वां द्रष्टुमपि संयुगे
verses.iast:
athavā vāsavena tvaṃ dharṣito'si mahābala |
vāsavasya tu kā śaktistvāṃ draṣṭumapi saṃyuge
verses.translation: "O the mighty lord! Otherwise, you might have been overpowered by Indra the lord of celestials. But for Indra, where is the capacity even to behold you in battle?

glosses.meaning: by Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
व्यक्तमेष महायोगी परमात्मा सनातनः |
अनादिमध्यनिधनो महतः परमो महान्
तमसः परमो धाता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः |
श्रीवत्सवक्षा नित्यश्रीरजय्यः शाश्वतो ध्रुवः
मानुषं रूपमास्थाय विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः |
सर्वैः परिवृतो देवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतैः
सर्वलोकेश्वरः श्रीमान् लोकानां हितकाम्यया |
सराक्षस परीवारम् हतवांस्त्वां महाद्युतिः
verses.iast:
vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ |
anādimadhyanidhano mahataḥ paramo mahān
tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṇ^khacakragadādharaḥ |
śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīrajayyaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ
mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
sarvaiḥ parivṛto devairvānaratvamupāgataiḥ
sarvalokeśvaraḥ śrīmān lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
sarākṣasa parīvāram hatavāṃstvāṃ mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: "This Rama is certainly a great ascetic, an eternal person, having no beginning middle or end, greater than distinguished universal spirit like Brahma, the one beyond ignorance, the nourisher, wielding a conch, a disc and a mace, wearing the 'Srivatsa' mark on his chest, of lasting beauty, incapable of being conquered, a perpetual one, being the constant soul of the universe, truly mighty, the lord of all the worlds, the prosperous one having a great splendour and Vishnu, the lord of maintenance of the world with a wish to benefit the worlds, assuming a human form surrounded by all the gods in the form of monkeys, Rama killed you, surrounded by demons.

glosses.meaning: wearing the 'Srivatsa' mark on his chest
the lord of all the worlds
and Vishnu the lord of maintenance of the world
with a wish for the benefit

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रियाणि पुरा जित्वा जितन् त्रिभुवणं त्वया |
स्मरद्भिरिव तद्वैरमिन्द्रियैरेव निर्जितः
verses.iast:
indriyāṇi purā jitvā jitan tribhuvaṇaṃ tvayā |
smaradbhiriva tadvairamindriyaireva nirjitaḥ
verses.translation: "In the past, by performing a great penance, you conquered the senses and conquered the three worlds. Now, as if revenging that enmity, those very senses conquered you."

glosses.meaning: in the past indriyaaNi = the senses

verses.devanagari:
यदैव हि जनस्थाने राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः |
खरस्तव हतो भ्राता तदैवासौ न मानुषः
यदैव नगरीन् लङ्कान् दुष्प्रवेषां सुरैरपि |
प्रविष्टो हनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम्
verses.iast:
yadaiva hi janasthāne rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ |
kharastava hato bhrātā tadaivāsau na mānuṣaḥ
yadaiva nagarīn lañkān duṣpraveṣāṃ surairapi |
praviṣṭo hanumānvīryāttadaiva vyathitā vayam
verses.translation: "The moment your brother Khara was killed by Rama in Janasthana, though surrounded by a multitude of demons, it became evident that Rama was really no mortal. We felt perturbed, the moment Hanuma penetrated, by dint of his prowess, deeply into the City of Lanka, which was difficult to be entered even for gods."

verses.devanagari:
क्रियतामविरोधश्च राघवेणेति यन्मया |
उच्यमानो न गृह्णासि तस्येयन् व्युष्टिरागता
verses.iast:
kriyatāmavirodhaśca rāghaveṇeti yanmayā |
ucyamāno na gṛhṇāsi tasyeyan vyuṣṭirāgatā
verses.translation: "This evil result has come upon you, since you did not heed to my advice, saying that no hostility should be entered into with Rama."

verses.devanagari:
अकस्माच्चाभिकामोअसि सीतान् राक्षसपुङ्गव |
ऐश्वर्यस्य विनाशाय देहस्य स्वजनस्य च
verses.iast:
akasmāccābhikāmoasi sītān rākṣasapuñgava |
aiśvaryasya vināśāya dehasya svajanasya ca
verses.translation: "O the foremost of demons! For the annihilation of your power, your body and your own people, you conceived a desire for Seetha suddenly."

verses.devanagari:
अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टान् तान् रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते |
सीतान् धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम्
verses.iast:
arundhatyā viśiṣṭān tān rohiṇyāścāpi durmate |
sītān dharṣayatā mānyāṃ tvayā hyasadṛśaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: "O the foolish one! An unworthy act was indeed done by you, in offending Seetha, who was more distinguished and more respectable than Arundhati (wife of sage Vasishta) and Rohini (the principal spouse of moon-god)."

glosses.meaning: and Rohini (the principal spouse of moon-god).

verses.devanagari:
वसुधाया हि वसुधां श्रियः श्रीं भर्तृवत्सलाम् |
सीतां सर्वानवद्याङ्गीमरण्ये विजने शुभाम्
आनयित्वा तु तां दीनां चद्मनात्मस्वदूषण |
अप्राप्य तं चैव कामं मैथिलीसंगमे कृतम्
पतिव्रतायास्तपसा नूनं दग्धोऽसि मे प्रभो |
verses.iast:
vasudhāyā hi vasudhāṃ śriyaḥ śrīṃ bhartṛvatsalām |
sītāṃ sarvānavadyāṇ^gīmaraṇye vijane śubhām
ānayitvā tu tāṃ dīnāṃ cadmanātmasvadūṣaṇa |
aprāpya taṃ caiva kāmaṃ maithilīsaṅgame kṛtam
pativratāyāstapasā nūnaṃ dagdho'si me prabho |
verses.translation: "O my lord, who annihilated yourself and your people! Seetha is the model of forbearance even to the Goddess Earth and a model of grace to Lakshmi, the goddess of fortune and charm. She is extremely fond of her husband. By a recourse to a fraud in bringing that Seetha in a lonely forest, faultless in every limb as she was, and charming though miserable, and having failed to fulfill your desire for union with Seetha and due to your own fault you have been surely consumed by the asceticism of that woman, devoted as she was to her husband."

glosses.meaning: who annihilated yourself and your people!
Seetha is the model of forbearance
she is extremely fond of her husband
who was living in a lonely forest
who was faultless of every limb
cherished by you for union with Seetha
by the asceticism of that woman

verses.devanagari:
तदैव यन्न दग्धस्त्वं धर्षयंस्तनुमध्यमाम्
देवा बिभ्यत ते सर्वे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः |
verses.iast:
tadaiva yanna dagdhastvaṃ dharṣayaṃstanumadhyamām
devā bibhyata te sarve sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ |
verses.translation: "It is because, the gods together with Indra the ruler of gods including those headed by the fire-god fear you, that you were not consumed even while you were laying hands on Seetha, the slender-waisted woman."

glosses.meaning: together with Indra the ruler of gods
including those headed by the fire-god

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यमेव लभते फलं पापस्य कर्मणः |
घोरं पर्यागते काले कर्ता नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.iast:
avaśyameva labhate phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ |
ghoraṃ paryāgate kāle kartā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "There is no doubt that when the time comes, the doer surely reaps a harsh fruit of his sinful deed."

verses.devanagari:
शुभकृच्छुभमाप्नोति पापकृत्पापमश्नुते |
विभीषणः सुखं प्राप्तस्त्वं प्राप्तः पापमीदृशम्
verses.iast:
śubhakṛcchubhamāpnoti pāpakṛtpāpamaśnute |
vibhīṣaṇaḥ sukhaṃ prāptastvaṃ prāptaḥ pāpamīdṛśam
verses.translation: "The doer of an auspicious act obtains happiness, while the doer of a sinful act reaps misery. While Vibhishana has obtained happiness, you met with such an evil destiny."

glosses.meaning: the doer of an auspicious act
the doer of a sinful act

verses.devanagari:
सन्त्यन्याः प्रमदास्तुभ्यं रूपेणाभ्यधिकास्ततः |
अनङ्गवशमापन्नस्त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे
verses.iast:
santyanyāḥ pramadāstubhyaṃ rūpeṇābhyadhikāstataḥ |
anaṇ^gavaśamāpannastvaṃ tu mohānna budhyase
verses.translation: "There are other women, more excellent in form than Seetha for you in your gynaecium. Having fallen a prey to the power of passion, you did not know it through ignorance."

verses.devanagari:
न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येन मैथिली |
मयाधिका वा तुल्या वा त्वन् तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे
verses.iast:
na kulena na rUpeṇa na dākṣiṇyena maithilī |
mayādhikā vā tulyā vā tvan tu mohānna budhyase
verses.translation: "Seetha is no match for me either in birth or in beauty or in amiability. You did not perceive this through infatuation."

verses.devanagari:
सर्वथा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः |
तव तावदयं मृत्युर्मैथिलीकृतलक्षणः
verses.iast:
sarvathā sarvabhUtānāṃ nāsti mṛtyuralakṣaṇaḥ |
tava tāvadayaṃ mṛtyurmaithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "At any time, there is no causeless death for any living being. As for you, this Seetha has become a cause."

glosses.meaning: the cause is in the form of this Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
सीतानिमित्तजो मृत्युस्त्वया दूरादुपाहृतः |
मैथिली सह रामेण विशोका विहरिष्यति
verses.iast:
sītānimittajo mṛtyustvayā dūrādupāhṛtaḥ |
maithilī saha rāmeṇa viśokā vihariṣyati
verses.translation: "Death which was brought about on account of Seetha was invited by you from a far-off distance. Free from sorrow, Seetha will now be enjoying herself with Rama."

glosses.meaning: born from a cause in the form of Seetha

verses.devanagari:
अल्पपुण्या त्वहन् घोरे पतिता शोकसागरे |
कैलासे मन्दरे मेरौ तथा चैत्ररथे वने
देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु विहृत्य सहिता त्वया |
विमानेनानुरूपेण या याम्यतुलया श्रिया
पश्यन्ती विविधान्देशान्स्तान्स्तांश्चित्रस्रगम्बरा |
भ्रंशिता कामभोगेभ्यः सास्मि वीरवधात्तव
verses.iast:
alpapuṇyā tvahan ghore patitā śokasāgare |
kailāse mandare merau tathā caitrarathe vane
devodyāneṣu sarveṣu vihṛtya sahitā tvayā |
vimānenānurUpeṇa yā yāmyatulayā śriyā
paśyantī vividhāndeśānstānstāṃścitrasragambarā |
bhraṃśitā kāmabhogebhyaḥ sāsmi vīravadhāttava
verses.translation: "I, however, whose stock of merit was deficient, have fallen into a terrific ocean of grief. I, who having enjoyed myself with you in suitable aerial cars in Mount Kailasa, mount Mandara, Mount Meru and in a grove named Chaitraratha and in all celestial gardens, decked as was with lovely garlands and clad in colorful robes and invested in matchless splendour, visiting and seeing various lands of every description have now been deprived of all sense- enjoyments because of your death. Though the same, I stand transformed into another as it were. Woe be to the flickering fortunes of kings!"

glosses.meaning: whose stock of merit was deficient
into a terrific ocean of grief
with lovely garlands and clad in colourful robes

verses.devanagari:
हा राजन् सुकुमारं ते सुभ्रु सुत्वक्समुन्नसम्
कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः |
किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितं ताम्रास्यं दीप्तकुण्डलम्
मदव्याकुललोलाक्षं भूत्वा यत्पानभूमिषु |
विविधस्रग्धरं चारु वल्गुस्मितकथं शुभम्
तदेवाद्य तवैवं हि वक्त्रं न भ्राजते प्रभो |
रामसायकनिर्भिन्नं रक्तं रुधिरविस्रवैः
वीशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कं रूक्षम् स्यन्दनरेणुभिः |
verses.iast:
hā rājan sukumāraṃ te subhru sutvaksamunnasam
kāntiśrīdyutibhistulyamindupadmadivākaraiḥ |
kirīṭakūṭojjvalitaṃ tāmrāsyaṃ dīptakuṇḍalam
madavyākulalolākṣaṃ bhūtvā yatpānabhūmiṣu |
vividhasragdharaṃ cāru valgusmitakathaṃ śubham
tadevādya tavaivaṃ hi vaktraṃ na bhrājate prabho |
rāmasāyakanirbhinnaṃ raktaṃ rudhiravisravaiḥ
vīśīrṇamedomastiṣkaṃ rūkṣam syandanareṇubhiḥ |
verses.translation: "Alas, O king! That face of yours which was so tender, O lord, and distinguished by charming eye-brows, a gloss surface, having an exceptionally prominent nose, coppery lips and brilliant ear-rings, which vied with the moon the lotus and the sun in loveliness, light and luster, was illumined by a number of diadems, which shone with its eyes wild and rolling through inebriety in banqueting places, bore garlands of various kinds, was lovely and charming in every way, was lit with a captivating smile and indulged in a delightful talk - that face of yours does not actually shine as before today pierced with Rama's arrows, it lies dyed with streams of blood. It has its marrow shattered and has got soiled through the dust raised by the chariots."

glosses.meaning: was illumined by a number of diadems
which shone with its eyes wild and rolling through inebriety
was lovely and charming (in every way)
was lit with a captivating smile and indulged in a delightful talk

verses.devanagari:
हा पश्चिमा मे संप्राप्त दशा वैधव्यदायिनी
या मयासीन्न संबुद्धा कदाचिदपि मन्दया |
verses.iast:
hā paścimā me samprāpta daśā vaidhavyadāyinī
yā mayāsīnna sambuddhā kadācidapi mandayā |
verses.translation: "Alas! The last stage of my life, which conferred widow ship on me, has come and which was never contemplated me at any time; a stupid woman as I am."

glosses.meaning: the last stage of my life

verses.devanagari:
पिता दानवराजो मे भर्ता मे राक्षसेश्वरः
पुत्रो मे शक्रनि र्जेता इत्यहं गर्विता भृशम् |
verses.iast:
pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ
putro me śakrani rjetā ityahaṃ garvitā bhṛśam |
verses.translation: "I was very much proud that my father was king of demons, my husband a lord of demons and my son, a conqueror of Indra the lord of celestials."

glosses.meaning: was a conqueror of Indra the lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
दृप्तारिमर्दनाः शूराः प्रख्यातबलपौरुषाः
अकुतश्चिद्भया नाथा ममेत्यासीन्मतिर्दृढा |
verses.iast:
dṛptārimardanāḥ śūrāḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣāḥ
akutaścidbhayā nāthā mametyāsīnmatirdṛḍhā |
verses.translation: "I had a firm conviction that my guardians were capable of crushing their arrogant adversaries, heroes as they were, renowned for their might and valour, and as such had no fear from any quarter."

glosses.meaning: were capable of crushing their arrogant adversaries
and as such had no fear from any quarter.

verses.devanagari:
तेषामेवंप्रभावाणां युष्माकं राक्षसर्षभाः
कथं भयमसंबुद्धं मानुषादिदमागतम् |
verses.iast:
teṣāmevamprabhāvāṇāṃ yuṣmākaṃ rākṣasarṣabhāḥ
kathaṃ bhayamasambuddhaṃ mānuṣādidamāgatam |
verses.translation: "How did this unknown danger come from a mortal to you, who were so powerful?"

verses.devanagari:
स्निग्देन्द्रनीलनीलं तु प्रांशुशैलोपमं महत्
केयूराङ्गदवैदूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् |
कान्तं विहारेष्वधिकं दीप्तं संग्रामभूमिषु
भात्यभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः |
तदेवाद्य शरीरं ते तीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम्
पुनर्दुर्लभसंस्पर्शं परिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते |
श्वाविधः शलकैर्यद्वद्बाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम्
स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसु भृशं संचिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् |
क्षितौ निपतितं राजन् श्यामं वै रुधिरच्छवि
व्ज्रप्रहाराभिहतो विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः |
verses.iast:
snigdendranīlanīlaṃ tu prāṃśuśailopamaṃ mahat
keyūrāṇ^gadavaidūryamuktāhārasragujjvalam |
kāntaṃ vihāreṣvadhikaṃ dīptaṃ saṅgrāmabhūmiṣu
bhātyabharaṇabhābhiryadvidyudbhiriva toyadaḥ |
tadevādya śarīraṃ te tīkṣṇairnaikaśaraiścitam
punardurlabhasaṃsparśaṃ pariṣvaktuṃ na śakyate |
śvāvidhaḥ śalakairyadvadbāṇairlagnairnirantaram
svarpitairmarmasu bhṛśaṃ sañcinnasnāyubandhanam |
kṣitau nipatitaṃ rājan śyāmaṃ vai rudhiracchavi
vjraprahārābhihato vikīrṇa iva parvataḥ |
verses.translation: "O king! The body of yours which was really dark as glossy sapphire, gigantic like a lofty mountain and resplendent with Keyuras and Angadas (two varieties of armlets) and necklace of cat's eye-gems and pearls and wreaths of flowers, which body looked more charming during your pleasure-walks and dazzling in battle-fields, which shone with luster of jewels as a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning lies transfixed in numerous sharp arrows today. Though it will be difficult for me to touch it again, it is no longer possible to embrace it. It has tendons cut to pieces, by arrows of Rama, dug deep into your vital parts and closely transfixed like the spines of a porcupine. Though dark of complexion, it is now transformed into the colour of blood and lies fallen on the ground like a mountain broken into pieces when hit by a stroke of thunder-bolt."

glosses.meaning: the very body of yours snigdhendraniila niilam = which was really dark as a glossy sapphire
and resplendent with Keyuras and Angadas (two varieties of armlets)
though it will be difficult for me to touch it again
it has tendons cut to pieces
it is now transformed into the colour of blood
when hit by a stroke of thunder-bolt.

verses.devanagari:
हा स्वप्नः सत्यमेवेदं त्वं रामेण कथं हतः
त्वं मृत्योरपि मृत्युः स्याः कथं मृत्युवशं गतः |
verses.iast:
hā svapnaḥ satyamevedaṃ tvaṃ rāmeṇa kathaṃ hataḥ
tvaṃ mṛtyorapi mṛtyuḥ syāḥ kathaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ |
verses.translation: "Alas! Is it a dream? Is it the reality? But, how could you be killed by Rama? You were the death, even to Death himself. How did you depart from this world, falling under the sway of Death?

glosses.meaning: even to the death himself katham = how
did you depart from this world
falling under the sway of death?.

verses.devanagari:
त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं त्रैलोक्योद्वेगदं महत्
जेतारं लोकपालानां क्षेप्तारं शंकरस्य च |
verses.iast:
trailokyavasubhoktāraṃ trailokyodvegadaṃ mahat
jetāraṃ lokapālānāṃ kṣeptāraṃ śaṅkarasya ca |
verses.translation: "My husband enjoyed the wealth of all the three worlds. He gave tremendous fear to the three worlds. He conquered the guardians of the worlds and lifted up Lord Shiva (along with his seat, Mount Kailasa)."

glosses.meaning: my husband enjoyed the wealth of all the three worlds
he gave tremendous fear to the three worlds

verses.devanagari:
दृप्तानां निग्रहीतारमाविष्कृतपराक्रमम्
लोकक्षोभयितारं च नादैर्भूतविराविणम् |
verses.iast:
dṛptānāṃ nigrahītāramāviṣkṛtaparākramam
lokakṣobhayitāraṃ ca nādairbhūtavirāviṇam |
verses.translation: "My husband held down those who were arrogant. He manifested his prowess and shook up the worlds. He caused the living beings to weep, with his roars."

glosses.meaning: He caused the living beings to weep

verses.devanagari:
ओजसा दृप्तवाक्यानां वक्तारं रिपुसंनिधौ
स्वयूथभृत्यगोप्तारं हन्तारंभीमकर्मणाम् |
verses.iast:
ojasā dṛptavākyānāṃ vaktāraṃ ripusaṃnidhau
svayūthabhṛtyagoptāraṃ hantārambhīmakarmaṇām |
verses.translation: "He used to utter arrogant words with vigour in the presence of his enemies. He was the protector for his troop and his servants. He was the killer of those who indulged in terrible acts."

glosses.meaning: in the presence of his enemies
he was the protector for his troop and to his servants
of those who indulged in terrible acts.

verses.devanagari:
हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणाम् यक्षाणां च सहस्रशः
निवातकवचानां च संग्रहीतारमाहवे |
verses.iast:
hantāraṃ dānavendrāṇām yakṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ
nivātakavacānāṃ ca saṅgrahītāramāhave |
verses.translation: "He was the killer of the lords of demons and Yakshas the super natural beings in thousands. He was drawing to himself, the demons called Nivatakavachas, in battles."

glosses.meaning: he was drawing the demons called Nivatakavachas to himself

verses.devanagari:
नैकयज्ञविलोप्तारं त्रातारं स्वजनस्य च
धर्मव्यवस्थाभेत्तारं मायास्रष्टारमाहवे |
verses.iast:
naikayajJṇaviloptāraṃ trātāraṃ svajanasya ca
dharmavyavasthābhettāraṃ māyāsraṣṭāramāhave |
verses.translation: "My husband ruined several sacrificial performances. He was the protector of his own people. He violated the moral order. He violated the moral order. He created conjuring tricks on the battle-field."

glosses.meaning: my husband ruined several sacrificial performances

verses.devanagari:
देवासुरनृकन्यानामाहर्तारं ततस्ततः
शत्रुस्त्रीशोकदातारं नेतारं स्वजनस्य च |
verses.iast:
devāsuranṛkanyānāmāhartāraṃ tatastataḥ
śatrustrīśokadātāraṃ netāraṃ svajanasya ca |
verses.translation: "He used to bring the virgin-daughters of gods, demons and human beings from here and there. He brought mourning to his enemy's wives. He was the leader of his own people."

glosses.meaning: he brought mourning to his enemy's wives

verses.devanagari:
लङ्काद्वीपस्य गोप्तारं कर्तारं भीमकर्मणाम्
अस्माकं कामभोगानां दातारं रथिनां वरम् |
verses.iast:
laṇ^kādvīpasya goptāraṃ kartāraṃ bhīmakarmaṇām
asmākaṃ kāmabhogānāṃ dātāraṃ rathināṃ varam |
verses.translation: "He was the protector of the island of Lanka. He was the doer of terrible deeds. He was the bestower of desires and sensual gratifications to us. He was excellent among the chariot-warriors."

glosses.meaning: he was the protector of the island of Lanka

verses.devanagari:
एवंप्रभावं भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा रामेण पातितम्
स्थिरास्मि या देहमिमं धारयामि हतप्रिया |
verses.iast:
evamprabhāvaṃ bhartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa pātitam
sthirāsmi yā dehamimaṃ dhārayāmi hatapriyā |
verses.translation: "Seeing my husband with such power struck down by Rama, I, having my husband killed, am hard-hearted indeed, still bearing this body."

verses.devanagari:
शयनेषु महार्हेषु शयित्वा राक्षसेश्वर
इह कस्मात्प्रासुप्तोऽसि धरण्यां रेणुगुण्ठितः |
verses.iast:
śayaneṣu mahārheṣu śayitvā rākṣaseśvara
iha kasmātprāsupto'si dharaṇyāṃ reṇuguṇṭhitaḥ |
verses.translation: "Having reposed on very valuable coaches, O the king of demons, why are you lying buried in sleep slumber on the bare ground and shrouded in dust?"

verses.devanagari:
यदा ते तनयः शस्तो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्युधि
तदा त्वभिहता तीच्रमद्य त्वस्मि निपातिता |
verses.iast:
yadā te tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajidyudhi
tadā tvabhihatā tīcramadya tvasmi nipātitā |
verses.translation: "When Indrajit, your son was killed in battle by Lakshmana, I was hard-hit then and today, of course, I am completely beaten down."

verses.devanagari:
साहं बन्धुजनैर्हीना हीना नाथेन च त्वया
विहीना कामभोगैश्च शोचिष्ये शाश्वतीः समाः |
verses.iast:
sāhaṃ bandhujanairhīnā hīnā nāthena ca tvayā
vihīnā kāmabhogaiśca śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
verses.translation: "Bereft of kinsfolk and forsaken by you, my lord, and deprived of desires and sensual enjoyments, I shall lament for ever more years."

verses.devanagari:
प्रपन्नो दीर्घमध्वानं राजन्नद्य सुदुर्गमम्
नय मामपि दुःखार्तां न वर्तिष्ये त्वया विना |
verses.iast:
prapanno dīrghamadhvānaṃ rājannadya sudurgamam
naya māmapi duḥkhārtāṃ na vartiṣye tvayā vinā |
verses.translation: "O king! Having embarked today on a long journey, which is very difficult to be traversed, take me too with you, tormented as I am with grief. I shall not survive without you."

glosses.meaning: tormented by grief as I am
without you = na vartiShy = I shall not survive.

verses.devanagari:
कस्मात्त्वं मां विहायेह कृपणाम् गन्तुमिच्छसि
दीनां विलपतीं मन्दां किं वा मां नाभिभाषसे |
verses.iast:
kasmāttvaṃ māṃ vihāyeha kṛpaṇām gantumicchasi
dīnāṃ vilapatīṃ mandāṃ kiṃ vā māṃ nābhibhāṣase |
verses.translation: "Why do you intend to go, leaving me here, miserable as I am? Why do you not speak to me, a sad and lamenting creature, and unfortunate as I am?"

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा न खल्वभिक्रुद्धो मामिहानवगुण्ठिताम्
निर्गतां नगरद्वारात्पद्भ्यामेवागतां प्रभो |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā na khalvabhikruddho māmihānavaguṇṭhitām
nirgatāṃ nagaradvārātpadbhyāmevāgatāṃ prabho |
verses.translation: "O Lord! Are you not indeed enraged, in seeing me on foot in this way out through the city-gate, unveiled and come on foot in the way?

verses.devanagari:
पश्येष्टदार दारांस्ते भ्रष्टलज्जावगुण्ठनान्
बहिर्निष्पतितान् सर्वान् कथं दृष्ट्वा न कुप्यसि |
verses.iast:
paśyeṣṭadāra dārāṃste bhraṣṭalajjāvaguṇṭhanān
bahirniṣpatitān sarvān kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na kupyasi |
verses.translation: "O lover of your consorts! Look at all your spouses, who came out, with their veils dropped off. Why are you not getting enraged in seeing this?"

glosses.meaning: out bhraShTa lajjaavaguNThanaan = with their veils dropped off
why are you not getting enraged

verses.devanagari:
अयम् क्रीडासहायस्तेऽनाथो लालप्यते जनः
न चैनमाश्वासयसि किं वा न बहुमन्यसे |
verses.iast:
ayam krīḍāsahāyaste'nātho lālapyate janaḥ
na cainamāśvāsayasi kiṃ vā na bahumanyase |
verses.translation: "This Mandodari, who was helping in your sport with you, is weeping with helplessness. You are not consoling her. Do you not have a high esteem of her?"

glosses.meaning: who was helping in your sport
do you not have a high esteem of her?.

verses.devanagari:
यास्त्वया विधवा राजन् क्ऱिता नैकाः कुलस्त्रियः
पतिव्रता धर्मरता गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः |
ताभिः शोकाभितप्ताभिः शप्तः परवशं गतः
त्वया विप्रकृताभिर्यत्तदा शप्तं तदागतम् |
verses.iast:
yāstvayā vidhavā rājan kRitā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ
pativratā dharmaratā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ |
tābhiḥ śokābhitaptābhiḥ śaptaḥ paravaśaṃ gataḥ
tvayā viprakṛtābhiryattadā śaptaṃ tadāgatam |
verses.translation: "You have fallen under the sway of your enemies in that you were cursed by the numerous women of noble lineage, who, though devoted to their husband, fond of piety and intent on the service of their elders, had been widowed by you, O king, and were accordingly tormented with grief. That curse which was pronounced at that time by those aggrieved women on their having been wronged by you, has fallen on you."

glosses.meaning: you have fallen under the sway
who though devoted to their husband
and intent on the service of their elders
and were accordingly tormented with grief
on their having been wronged by you

verses.devanagari:
प्रवादः सत्य एवायं त्वां प्रति प्रायशो नृप
पतिव्रतानां नाकस्मात्पतन्त्यश्रूनि भूतले |
verses.iast:
pravādaḥ satya evāyaṃ tvāṃ prati prāyaśo nṛpa
pativratānāṃ nākasmātpatantyaśrūni bhūtale |
verses.translation: "The popular saying that �the tears of virtuous wives d not generally fall on the ground in vain' has come out probably true in your case O king!"

verses.devanagari:
कथं च नाम ते राजन् लोकानाक्रम्य तेजसा
नारीचौर्यमिदं क्षुद्रं कृतं शौण्डीर्यमानिना |
verses.iast:
kathaṃ ca nāma te rājan lokānākramya tejasā
nārīcauryamidaṃ kṣudraṃ kṛtaṃ śauṇḍīryamāninā |
verses.translation: "How was this mean act of abducting a lady, done by you, who having invaded the three worlds, were proud f your prowess?"

glosses.meaning: by you who were proud of your prowess

verses.devanagari:
अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामं यन्मृगच्चद्मना त्वया
आनीता रामपत्नी स तत्ते कातर्यलक्षणम् |
verses.iast:
apanīyāśramādrāmaṃ yanmṛgaccadmanā tvayā
ānītā rāmapatnī sa tatte kātaryalakṣaṇam |
verses.translation: "It was indeed a mark of your cowardice that Rama's consort was borne away by you, after luring away Rama from his hermitage in the pretext of deer"

glosses.meaning: was a mark of your cowardice
Rama's consort yat aamiitaa = was a = by you
in the pretext of a deer

verses.devanagari:
कातर्यं न च ते युद्धे कदाचित्संस्मराम्यहम्
तत्तु भाग्यविपर्यासान्नूनं ते पक्वलक्षणम् |
verses.iast:
kātaryaṃ na ca te yuddhe kadācitsaṃsmarāmyaham
tattu bhāgyaviparyāsānnūnaṃ te pakvalakṣaṇam |
verses.translation: "I do not recall your faint-heartedness at any time on the battle-field. That case of abduction of Seetha, however, was due to your ill-luck and certainly as the result of your sins."

glosses.meaning: as the result of your sins

verses.devanagari:
अतीतानागतार्थज्ञो वर्तमानविचक्षणः
मैथिलीमाहृताम् दृष्ट्वा ध्यात्वा निःश्वस्य चायतम् |
सत्यवाक्स महाबाहो देवरो मे यदब्रवीत्
अयन् राक्षसमुख्यानां विनाशः पर्युपस्थितः |
कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन व्यसनेन प्रसङ्गिना
verses.iast:
atītānāgatārthajJṇo vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ
maithilīmāhṛtām dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā niḥśvasya cāyatam |
satyavāksa mahābāho devaro me yadabravīt
ayan rākṣasamukhyānāṃ vināśaḥ paryupasthitaḥ |
kāmakrodhasamutthena vyasanena prasañginā
verses.translation: "O the mighty armed one! Whatever my younger brother-in-law, Vibhishana who knows matters relating to the pat and of the future and also conversant with the present said after reflecting and sighing for long, on seeing Seetha abducted by you: 'The destruction of the chiefs among the demons now is imminent, have become true words. This misfortune had come from the lust, wrath and addiction to the vice of deep attachment."

glosses.meaning: who knows matters relating to the past and of the future
and also conversant with the present
of the chiefs among the demons
and addiction to the vice of deep attachment.

verses.devanagari:
निर्वृत्तस्त्वत्कृतेऽनर्थः सोऽयं मूलहरो महान् |
त्वया कृतमिदन् सर्वमनाथं रक्षसान् कुलम्
verses.iast:
nirvṛttastvatkṛte'narthaḥ so'yaṃ mūlaharo mahān |
tvayā kṛtamidan sarvamanāthaṃ rakṣasān kulam
verses.translation: "This major disaster occurred, destroying our very root, because of you. This entire race of demons has been deprived of its protector, by you."

glosses.meaning: has been deprived of its protector

verses.devanagari:
न हि त्वन् शोचितव्यो मे प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः |
स्त्रीस्वभावात्तु मे बुद्धिः कारुण्ये परिवर्तते
verses.iast:
na hi tvan śocitavyo me prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ |
strīsvabhāvāttu me buddhiḥ kāruṇye parivartate
verses.translation: "You, who were far illustrious for your strength and prowess, do not deserve to be lamented for by me. But, because of feminine nature, my mind is leaning towards melancholy."

glosses.meaning: do not deserve to be lamented for

verses.devanagari:
सुकृतन् दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः |
आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखिताम्
verses.iast:
sukṛtan duṣkṛtaṃ ca tvaṃ gṛhītvā svāṃ gatiṃ gataḥ |
ātmānamanuśocāmi tvadviyogena duḥkhitām
verses.translation: "By taking away your merit and sin, you obtained your course of fate. I, however, mourn for my own self, so afflicted as I am, by your death."

verses.devanagari:
सुहृदां हितकामानां न श्रुतं वचनं त्वया |
भ्रातृइणां चैव कार्त्स्न्येन हितमुक्तं दशानन
verses.iast:
suhṛdāṃ hitakāmānāṃ na śrutaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā |
bhrātṛiṇāṃ caiva kārtsnyena hitamuktaṃ daśānana
verses.translation: "O Ravana! You did not hear the advice of your friends, who wish for your welfare. Nor did you hear the words of your brothers completely."

verses.devanagari:
हेत्वर्थयुक्तं विधिवच्छ्रेयस्करमदारुणम् |
विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतं हेतुमत्त्वया
verses.iast:
hetvarthayuktaṃ vidhivacchreyaskaramadāruṇam |
vibhīṣaṇenābhihitaṃ na kṛtaṃ hetumattvayā
verses.translation: "The counsel offered by Vibhishana, which was endowed with reason, meaning, rule of conduct, wholesome, gentle and well-founded, was not implemented by you."

glosses.meaning: which was endowed with reason and meaning

verses.devanagari:
मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यां वाक्यं मम पितुस्तथा |
न श्रुतं वीर्यमत्तेन तस्येदं फलमीदृशम्
verses.iast:
mārīcakumbhakarṇābhyāṃ vākyaṃ mama pitustathā |
na śrutaṃ vīryamattena tasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam
verses.translation: "The advices offered by Mareecha, Kumbhakarna, myself and my father have not been heeded by you, who were arrogant of your prowess. What is followed is a bitter consequence of your perversity."

glosses.meaning: the advices offered by Mareecha and Kumbhakarna
is a bitter consequence (of your perversity).

verses.devanagari:
नीलजीमूतसंकाश पीताम्भर शुभाङ्गद |
स्वगात्राणि विनिक्षिप्य किं शेषे रुधिराप्लुतः
verses.iast:
nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśa pītāmbhara śubhāṇ^gada |
svagātrāṇi vinikṣipya kiṃ śeṣe rudhirāplutaḥ
verses.translation: "My lord, resembling a dark cloud in hue, clad in yellow and decked with brilliant armlets, why are you lying with your limbs, cast away on the ground and bathed in blood?"

verses.devanagari:
प्रसुप्त इव शोकार्तां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे |
महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः
यातुधानस्य दौहित्र किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे |
verses.iast:
prasupta iva śokārtāṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase |
mahāvīryasya dakṣasya saṃyugeṣvapalāyinaḥ
yātudhānasya dauhitra kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase |
verses.translation: "As though fast asleep, why are you not replying to me, the granddaughter of Somali the demon who was clever, endowed with extraordinary prowess and never retreated in battles, tormented with grief as I am?"

glosses.meaning: tormented with grief as I am.

verses.devanagari:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ट किं शेषे नवे परिभवे कृते
अद्य वै निर्भया लङ्कां प्रविष्टाः सूर्यरश्मयः |
verses.iast:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭa kiṃ śeṣe nave paribhave kṛte
adya vai nirbhayā laṇ^kāṃ praviṣṭāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ |
verses.translation: "Arise, arise! Why are you lying down, though subjected to a fresh insult? The sun's rays have penetrated deep into Lanka today, without any fear."

verses.devanagari:
येन सूदयसे शत्रून् समरे सूर्यवर्चसा
वज्रं वज्रधरस्येव सोऽयं ते सततार्चितः |
रणे बहुप्रहरणो हेमजालपरिष्कृतः
परिघो व्यवकीर्णस्ते बाणैश्छिन्नः सहस्रधा |
verses.iast:
yena sūdayase śatrūn samare sūryavarcasā
vajraṃ vajradharasyeva so'yaṃ te satatārcitaḥ |
raṇe bahupraharaṇo hemajālapariṣkṛtaḥ
parigho vyavakīrṇaste bāṇaiśchinnaḥ sahasradhā |
verses.translation: "Torn into thousand pieces, that iron bludgeon of yours, which was brilliant as the sun, like a thunderbolt of Indra, with which you killed your enemies in the battle-field, which was constantly honoured by you, which had struck many in battle and which was decked with gold, lies scattered."

glosses.meaning: which was brilliant as the sun
which was constantly honoured by you
and which was decked with gold

verses.devanagari:
प्रियामिवोपसंगृह्य किम् शेषे रणमेदिनीम्
अप्रियामिव कस्माच्च मां नेच्छस्यभिभाषितुम् |
verses.iast:
priyāmivopasaṅgṛhya kim śeṣe raṇamedinīm
apriyāmiva kasmācca māṃ necchasyabhibhāṣitum |
verses.translation: Why are you lying down, embracing the battle-ground, as one would embrace a loved one? Why do you not feel inclined to reply to me, as though I were abhorrent to you?"

glosses.meaning: as one would embrace a loved one?
as though I were abhorrent (to you)?

verses.devanagari:
धिगस्तु हृदयन् यस्या ममेदं न सहस्रधा
त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने फलते शोकपीडितम् |
verses.iast:
dhigastu hṛdayan yasyā mamedaṃ na sahasradhā
tvayi pañcatvamāpanne phalate śokapIḍitam |
verses.translation: "Woe be to me, that my heart is not bursting into pieces, tormented as I am with grief, now that you have returned to the five elements."

glosses.meaning: tormented as I am with grief

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवं विलपन्ती सा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा
स्नेहोपस्कन्नहृदया तदा मोहमुपागमत् |
verses.iast:
ityevaṃ vilapantī sā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā
snehopaskannahṛdayā tadā mohamupāgamat |
verses.translation: Lamenting thus, with her eyes filled with tears and her heart moistened with love, Mandodari, at that time, fell into a swoon.

glosses.meaning: with her eyes filled with tears
and her heart moistened with love

verses.devanagari:
कश्मलाभिहता सन्ना बभौ सा रावणोरसि
संध्यानुरक्ते जलदे दीप्ता विद्युदिवोज्ज्वला |
verses.iast:
kaśmalābhihatā sannā babhau sā rāvaṇorasi
sandhyānurakte jalade dīptā vidyudivojjvalā |
verses.translation: Fallen on the breast of Ravana, that dispirited Mandodari, stricken as she was with grief, shone like a vivid flash of lightning across a rainy cloud, reddened by the flow of twilight.

glosses.meaning: stricken as she was with grief
like a vivid flash of lightning
reddened by the glow of twilight.

verses.devanagari:
तथागतां समुत्थाप्य सपत्न्यस्तां भृशातुराः
पर्यवस्थापयामासू रुदन्त्यो रुदतीं भृशम् |
verses.iast:
tathāgatāṃ samutthāpya sapatnyastāṃ bhṛśāturāḥ
paryavasthāpayāmāsū rudantyo rudatīṃ bhṛśam |
verses.translation: Raising up Mandodari, who was in that condition bitterly weeping, her co-wives who were also weeping, very much distressed as they were, began to console her (as follows):

glosses.meaning: very much distressed as they were

verses.devanagari:
किं ते न विदिता देवि लोकानां स्थितिरध्रुवा
दशाविभागपर्याये राज्ञां वै चञ्चलाः श्रियः |
verses.iast:
kiṃ te na viditā devi lokānāṃ sthitiradhruvā
daśāvibhāgaparyāye rājJṇāṃ vai caJṇcalāḥ śriyaḥ |
verses.translation: "Don't you know the uncertain state of the worlds, O queen, that the wealth of kings is unsteady, when there is a change in the tide of their fate?"

glosses.meaning: O queen! raajJNaam shriyaH = that wealth of kings
when there is a change in the tide of their fate?

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवमुच्यमाना सा सशब्दं प्ररुदोद ह
स्नापयन्ती तदास्रेण स्तनौ वक्त्रं सुनिर्मलम् |
verses.iast:
ityevamucyamānā sā saśabdaṃ prarudoda ha
snāpayantī tadāsreṇa stanau vaktraṃ sunirmalam |
verses.translation: While they were consoling thus, Mandodari, moistening her breasts and her spotless face in tears, wept aloud at that moment.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह
सन्स्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रियश्चैता निवर्तय |
verses.iast:
etasminnantare rāmo vibhIṣaṇamuvāca ha
sanskāraḥ kriyatāṃ bhrātuḥ striyaścaitā nivartaya |
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, Rama spoke to Vibhishana as follows: "Let the obsequies of your brother be performed and let these crews of women be consoled."

glosses.meaning: to Vibhishana (as follows): bhraatuH = samskaaraH = let the obsequies of your brother

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच ततो धीमान् विभीषण इदं वचः
विमृश्य बुद्ध्या धर्मज्ञो धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् |
verses.iast:
tamuvāca tato dhīmān vibhīṣaṇa idaṃ vacaḥ
vimṛśya buddhyā dharmajJṇo dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam |
verses.translation: Reflecting with his intellect, the intelligent Vibhishana, the knower of virtue, thereupon, spoke to Rama, the following words, which were in conformity with righteousness and self-interest.

glosses.meaning: which were in conformity with righteousness

verses.devanagari:
त्यक्तधर्मव्रतन् क्रूरं नृशन्समनृतं तथा
नाहमर्होअस्मि सन्स्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शकम् |
verses.iast:
tyaktadharmavratan krUraṃ nṛśansamanṛtaṃ tathā
nāhamarhoasmi sanskartuṃ paradārābhimarśakam |
verses.translation: "I am not obliged to perform the obsequies to him, who had abandoned the vow of virtue, who was cruel, who killed human beings, who was a cheater and who had longed for others' wives."

glosses.meaning: and who was longing for others' wives.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातृरूपो हि मे शत्रुरेष सर्वाहिते रतः
रावणो नार्हते पूजां पूज्योअपि गुरुगौरवात् |
verses.iast:
bhrātṛrUpo hi me śatrureṣa sarvāhite rataḥ
rāvaṇo nārhate pUjāṃ pUjyoapi gurugauravāt |
verses.translation: "This Ravana, who was interested in wishing evil to all, though venerable as a respectable elder, is not fit for honour. He is my enemy, in the guise of a brother."

glosses.meaning: in the form of a brother.

verses.devanagari:
नृशन्स इति मान् राम वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि
श्रुत्वा तस्य गुणान्सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः |
verses.iast:
nṛśansa iti mān rāma vakṣyanti manujā bhuvi
śrutvā tasya guṇānsarve vakṣyanti sukṛtaṃ punaḥ |
verses.translation: "If I do not perform obsequies, O Rama, the human beings on earth will speak about me as ruthless. But, on hearing about his bad qualities all of them will speak of it as a good act."

glosses.meaning: as ruthless (if I do not perform obsequies)

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतान् वरः
विभीषणमुवाचेदन् वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम् |
verses.iast:
tacchrutvā paramaprīto rāmo dharmabhṛtān varaḥ
vibhīṣaṇamuvācedan vākyaGYo vākyakovidam |
verses.translation: Hearing those words, Rama the best among the supporters of virtue and skilled in speech, was very much pleased and spoke the following words to Vibhishana, the intelligent one in his speech.

verses.devanagari:
तवापि मे प्रियन् कार्यं त्वत्प्रभवाच्च मे जितम्
अवश्यन् तु क्षमन् वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर |
verses.iast:
tavāpi me priyan kāryaṃ tvatprabhavācca me jitam
avaśyan tu kṣaman vācyo mayā tvaṃ rākṣaseśvara |
verses.translation: "O king of demons! I too have to do a favour to you. I won the battle because of you. Certainly I have to give you an appropriate advice."

verses.devanagari:
अधर्मानृतसन्युक्तः काममेष निशाचरः
तेजस्वी बलवाञ्शूरः सङ्ग्रामेषु च नित्यशः |
verses.iast:
adharmānṛtasanyuktaḥ kāmameṣa niśācaraḥ
tejasvī balavāñśUraḥ sañgrāmeṣu ca nityaśaḥ |
verses.translation: "This demon may be full of unrighteousness and falsehood. But, he was brilliant, strong and ever a brave warrior in battles."

glosses.meaning: may be full of unrighteous and falsehood

verses.devanagari:
शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः
महात्मा बलसम्पन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः |
verses.iast:
śatakratumukhairdevaiḥ śrūyate na parājitaḥ
mahātmā balasampanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "It is heard that Ravana who was mighty, endowed with strength and who was causing people to cry, was not conquered by the chiefs like Indra and others."

glosses.meaning: and who was causing people to cry

verses.devanagari:
मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम्
क्रियतामस्य सन्स्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव |
verses.iast:
maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṃ naḥ prayojanam
kriyatāmasya sanskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava |
verses.translation: "Hostilities end with death. Our purpose has been accomplished. Let his funeral rites be performed. He is even as good mine also, as yours."

verses.devanagari:
त्वत्सकाशान्महाबाहो सन्स्कारन् विधिपूर्वकम्
पाप्तु मर्हति धर्मेण त्वं यशोभाग्भविष्यसि |
verses.iast:
tvatsakāśānmahābāho sanskāran vidhipūrvakam
pāptu marhati dharmeṇa tvaṃ yaśobhāgbhaviṣyasi |
verses.translation: "According to rule, Ravana is eligible to get the last rites on his dead body from you, by usage. You will also become fit for glory."

glosses.meaning: will become yashobhaak = fit for glory.

verses.devanagari:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः
सन्स्कारेणानुरूपेण भ्रातरं रावणम् हतम् |
verses.iast:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
sanskāreṇānurūpeṇa bhrātaraṃ rāvaṇam hatam |
verses.translation: Having heard the words of Rama, Vibhishana in haste began to do obsequies to Ravana, his dead brother.

verses.devanagari:
स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः
रावनस्याग्निहोत्रं तु निर्यापयति सत्वरम् |
verses.iast:
sa praviśya purīṃ laṇ^kāṃ rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ
rāvanasyāgnihotraṃ tu niryāpayati satvaram |
verses.translation: Entering the City of Lanka, that Vibhishana, the lord of demons, quickly concluded the Agnihotra (the act of pouring oblations into the sacred fire) carried on by Ravana.

glosses.meaning: the Agnihotra (act of poring oblations into the sacred fire)

verses.devanagari:
शकटान् दारुरूपाणि अग्नीन् वै याजकांस्तथा
तथा चन्दनकाष्ठानि काष्ठानि विविधानि च |
अगरूणि सुगन्धीनि गन्धांश्च सुरभींस्तथा
मणिमुक्ताप्रवाळानि निर्यापयति राक्षसः |
verses.iast:
śakaṭān dārurūpāṇi agnīn vai yājakāṃstathā
tathā candanakāṣṭhāni kāṣṭhāni vividhāni ca |
agarūṇi sugandhīni gandhāṃśca surabhīṃstathā
maṇimuktāpravāLāni niryāpayati rākṣasaḥ |
verses.translation: Vibhishana actually caused to be brought together, carts, excellent varieties of firewood, the three sacred fires and the priests required to officiate at the obsequies, logs of sandalwood, various types of firewood, pieces of fragrant aloe-wood, odorous perfumes, as well as gems, pearls and corals.

glosses.meaning: actually caused to be brought together
the priests required to officiate at the obsequies

verses.devanagari:
आ जगाम मुहूर्तेन राक्षसैः परिवारितः
ततो माल्यवता सार्धं क्रियामेव चकार सः |
verses.iast:
ā jagāma muhūrtena rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ
tato mālyavatā sārdhaṃ kriyāmeva cakāra saḥ |
verses.translation: Surrounded with demons, he came back for a while and thereupon, Vibhishana along with malyavan (the father of his own mother) initiated the obsequies.

glosses.meaning: together with Malyavan (the father of his own mother)

verses.devanagari:
सौवर्णीं शिबिकां दिव्यामारोप्य क्षौमवाससम्
रावणं राक्षसाधिशमश्रुपूर्णमुखा द्विजाः |
तूर्यघोषैश्च विविधैः स्तुवद्भिश्चाभिनन्दितम्
पताकाभिश्च चित्राभिः सुमनोभिश्च चित्रिताम् |
उत्क्षिप्य शिबिकां तां तु विभीषणपुरोगमाः
दक्षिणाभिमुखाः सर्वे गृह्य काष्ठानि भेजिरे |
verses.iast:
sauvarṇīṃ śibikāṃ divyāmāropya kṣaumavāsasam
rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhiśamaśrupūrṇamukhā dvijāḥ |
tūryaghoṣaiśca vividhaiḥ stuvadbhiścābhinanditam
patākābhiśca citrābhiḥ sumanobhiśca citritām |
utkṣipya śibikāṃ tāṃ tu vibhīṣaṇapurogamāḥ
dakṣiṇābhimukhāḥ sarve gṛhya kāṣṭhāni bhejire |
verses.translation: Placing Ravana, the lord of demons, who was covered with linen, accompanied by blasts of various musical instruments as well as panegyrists singing his the Brahmanas (forming part of the demon's race, which was apparently divided into four classes, like human beings) stood around him with their faces filled in tears. Lifting up that palanquin, which had been decorated with colorful flags and flowers and taking up blocks of wood, all the demons for their part, with Vibhishana in front, proceeded with their face turned towards the south.

glosses.meaning: hailed with blasts of various musical instruments
all Brahmanas (forming part of the demon's race
(stood round him) with their faces filled with tears
all the demons for their part with Vibhishana in front
with their faces turned towards the south.

verses.devanagari:
अग्नयो दीप्यमानास्ते तदाध्वर्युसमीरिताः
शरणाभिगताह् सर्वे पुरस्तत्तस्य ते ययुः |
verses.iast:
agnayo dīpyamānāste tadādhvaryusamīritāḥ
śaraṇābhigatāh sarve purastattasya te yayuḥ |
verses.translation: Those sacrificial fires were ignited and re-animated, as they were, by Adhvaryu priests, the performers of the sacrificial act, at that time. Those sacrificial fires were contained in earthen pots and went in front of Ravana's body.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तःपुराणि सर्वाणि रुदमानानि सत्वरम्
पृष्ठतोऽनुययुस्तानि प्लवमानानि सर्वतः |
verses.iast:
antaḥpurāṇi sarvāṇi rudamānāni satvaram
pṛṣṭhato'nuyayustāni plavamānāni sarvataḥ |
verses.translation: All those women of the gynaecium, while weeping, followed at his heels with quick paces, stumbling, as they were, on all sides.

glosses.meaning: followed at his heels with quick paces

verses.devanagari:
रावणम् प्रयते देशे स्थाप्य ते भृशदुःखिताः
चितां चन्दनकाष्ठैश्च पद्मकोशीरसंवृताम् |
ब्राह्म्या संवर्तयामासू राङ्कवास्तरणावृताम्
वर्तते वेदविहितो राज्ञो वै पश्चिमः क्रतुः |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇam prayate deśe sthāpya te bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
citāṃ candanakāṣṭhaiśca padmakośīrasaṃvṛtām |
brāhmyā saṃvartayāmāsū rāṇ^kavāstaraṇāvṛtām
vartate vedavihito rājJṇo vai paścimaḥ kratuḥ |
verses.translation: Keeping the body of Ravana on a consecrated spot, Vibhishana and others, who were very much afflicted with grief, piled up a sacred pyre, with logs of sandalwood, moistened with perfumes called Padmaka and Koshira and covered with the skin of black antelopes, turned about to perform the obsequies in accordance with Vedic rites in honour of the king.

glosses.meaning: who were very much afflicted with grief
moistened with perfumes called Padmaka and Koshira
covered with the skin of black antelopes
in accordance = with the Vedic rites

verses.devanagari:
प्रचक्रू राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पित्ऱ्^मेधमनुत्तमम्
वेदिं च दक्षिणप्राच्यां यथास्थानं च पावकम् |
verses.iast:
pracakrū rākṣasendrasya pitR^medhamanuttamam
vediṃ ca dakṣiṇaprācyāṃ yathāsthānaṃ ca pāvakam |
verses.translation: They performed the ancestral oblations to Ravana in a superb way. They constructed an altar in the south-east the funeral pile) and placed the sacred fire in its proper place.

glosses.meaning: in the south-east (of the funeral pile)
and placed the sacred fire in its proper place.

verses.devanagari:
पृषदाज्येन संपूर्णं स्रुवं स्कन्धे प्रचिक्षिपुः
पादयोः शकटं प्रादुरूर्वोश्चोलूखलं तदा |
verses.iast:
pṛṣadājyena sampūrṇaṃ sruvaṃ skandhe pracikṣipuḥ
pādayoḥ śakaṭaṃ prādurūrvoścolūkhalaṃ tadā |
verses.translation: They poured a ladle-full of ghee mixed with curds on his shoulders, placed a cart at his feet and then a wooden mortar at his thighs.

verses.devanagari:
दारुपात्रानि सर्वाणि अरणिं चोत्तरारणिम्
दत्त्वा तु मुसलं चान्यं यथास्थानं विचक्रमुः |
verses.iast:
dārupātrāni sarvāṇi araṇiṃ cottarāraṇim
dattvā tu musalaṃ cānyaṃ yathāsthānaṃ vicakramuḥ |
verses.translation: Having set at their proper place, all the wooden vessels (used in Agnihotra), the lower piece of wood used for kindling fire at a sacrifice and the upper piece of wood (which is rotated at great speed on to lower one, to produce fire by friction), the wooden pestle and other things used in the sacrifice, they circled around the funeral pyre.

glosses.meaning: the lower piece of wood used for kindling fire at a sacrifice
and the upper wood (which is rotated at great spped
the wooden pestle used in the sacrifice
they circled around the funeral pyre.

verses.devanagari:
शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना महर्षिविहितेन च
तत्र मेध्यं पशुं हत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः |
परिस्तरणीकां राज्ञोघृताक्तां समवेशयन्
verses.iast:
śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā maharṣivihitena ca
tatra medhyaṃ paśuṃ hatvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ |
paristaraṇīkāṃ rājJṇoghṛtāktāṃ samaveśayan
verses.translation: According to ordinance laid down by eminent sages and according to the rules viewed in Vedas, having sacrificed a goat fit for sacrifice at that spot, the demons dampened with ghee on Ravana the King of demons.

glosses.meaning: according to ordinance laid down by eminent sages
and according to the rules viewed in the Vedas
spread the limbs of the dead goat

verses.devanagari:
गन्धैर्माल्यैरलंकृत्य रावणं दीनामानसाः
विभीषणसहायास्ते वस्त्त्रैश्च विविधैरपि |
लाजैरवकिरन्ति स्म बाष्पपूर्णमुखास्तथा
verses.iast:
gandhairmālyairalaṅkṛtya rāvaṇaṃ dīnāmānasāḥ
vibhīṣaṇasahāyāste vasttraiśca vividhairapi |
lājairavakiranti sma bāṣpapūrṇamukhāstathā
verses.translation: Having decorated the body of Ravana with perfumes, garlands and various kinds of clothes; those demons accompanied by Vibhishana, distressed as they were in their minds, poured parched grains of rice, with their faces bathed in tears.

glosses.meaning: and who were distressed in mind
and baaShpapuurNa mukhaaH = and with their faces bathed in tears

verses.devanagari:
स ददौ पावकन् तस्य विधियुक्तन् विभीषणः |
स्नात्वा चैवार्द्रवस्त्रेण तिलान् दर्भविमिश्रितान्
उदकेन च संमिश्रान् प्रदाय विधिपूर्वकम् |
प्रदाय चोदकं तस्मै मूर्ध्ना चैनं नमस्य च
ताः स्त्रियोअनुनयामास सान्त्वमुक्त्वा पुनः पुनः |
गम्यतामिति ताः सर्वा विविशुर्नगरं ततः
verses.iast:
sa dadau pāvakan tasya vidhiyuktan vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
snātvā caivārdravastreṇa tilān darbhavimiśritān
udakena ca saṃmiśrān pradāya vidhipūrvakam |
pradāya codakaṃ tasmai mūrdhnā cainaṃ namasya ca
tāḥ striyoanunayāmāsa sāntvamuktvā punaḥ punaḥ |
gamyatāmiti tāḥ sarvā viviśurnagaraṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: That Vibhishana set fire to Ravana, according to the rules in the scriptures. Washing himself and offering in his wet clothes, according to scriptural ordinance, sesame seeds mixed with water, as well as blades of Kusha grass and offering obeisance to Ravana by bowing his head, Vibhishana entreated those women to return, consoling them again and again. Then, all of the returned to the City.

glosses.meaning: according to the rules in scriptures
as well as blades of sacred Kusha grass

verses.devanagari:
प्रविष्टासु च सर्वासु राक्षसीषु विभीषणः |
रामपार्श्वमुपागम्य तदातिष्ठद्विनीतवत्
verses.iast:
praviṣṭāsu ca sarvāsu rākṣasīṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
rāmapārśvamupāgamya tadātiṣṭhadvinītavat
verses.translation: When those women were re-entering the City, Vibhishana the lord of demons on approaching Rama's vicinity then remained standing there with humility.

verses.devanagari:
रामोअपि सह सैन्येन ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः |
हर्षन् लेभे रिपुं हत्वा यथा वृत्रं वज्रधरो यथा
verses.iast:
rāmoapi saha sainyena sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ |
harṣan lebhe ripuṃ hatvā yathā vṛtraṃ vajradharo yathā
verses.translation: Having destroyed the enemy, Rama too experienced happiness, along with his army as well as with Sugreeva and Lakshmana, even as Indra the wielder of thunderbolt did on destroying Vritra the demon.

glosses.meaning: did on destroying Vritra the demon.

verses.devanagari:
ततो विमुक्त्वा सशरं शरासनं |
महेन्द्रदत्तं कवचं च तन्महत् |
विमुच्य रोषं रिपुनिग्रहात्ततो |
रामः सुसौम्यत्वमुपागतोऽरिह
verses.iast:
tato vimuktvā saśaraṃ śarāsanaṃ |
mahendradattaṃ kavacaṃ ca tanmahat |
vimucya roṣaṃ ripunigrahāttato |
rāmaḥ susaumyatvamupāgato'riha
verses.translation: Thereupon, taking off his bow and arrows as also that great armour endowed to him by Indra, Rama the annihilator of his enemies, taking off his anger too, because of the enemy's defeat, then obtained a charming benevolence.

glosses.meaning: because of the defeat of his enemy
